raised.title: Raised
raised.about: Part of a line raised and smaller: a currency sign ($), a unit, a mark after a name. sup keeps its line's height (base.css).

muted.title: Muted
muted.about: Part of a line quieter but still readable: a unit, a note (/mo, per person).

badge.title: Badge
badge.about: A word in a line as a small label: New, Sale, Beta. Its shape is the chip's, its color a tint of primary.
